# Dynamic declarations in a WORKSPACE: a hub rule called with a computed
# lock, a `pycross_lock_repo` whose lock is an argument of a nested call, and
# a ruleset whose rule is loaded and never seen called (a signal).

=== .bazelversion
7.7.2
=== WORKSPACE
workspace(name = "app")

load("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_archive")

http_archive(
    name = "rules_python",
    strip_prefix = "rules_python-0.31.0",
    url = "https://github.com/bazelbuild/rules_python/releases/download/0.31.0/rules_python-0.31.0.tar.gz",
)

load("@rules_python//python:pip.bzl", "pip_parse")

LOCKS = ["//:requirements.txt"]

pip_parse(
    name = "pypi",
    requirements_lock = LOCKS[0],
)

load("@rules_jvm_external//:defs.bzl", "maven_install")
load("@external_macros//:deps.bzl", "java_deps")

java_deps(maven_install)

load("@rules_pycross//pycross:workspace.bzl", "lock_repo_model_uv", "pycross_lock_repo")

pycross_lock_repo(
    name = "pycross",
    lock_model = lock_repo_model_uv(lock_file = "//:uv.lock", project_file = "//:pyproject.toml"),
)
